$comment: Single source of truth for level backdrop art. Read by the app (rendering) and by scripts/gen-level-art.mjs (AI generation). Add a level by appending an entry here, then run the preview harness.
style: 16-bit pixel art, crisp clean pixels, cohesive night palette deep blue violet with warm orange window light and magenta cyan neon accents, dithering, retro snes game art, no text, no watermark, no people

world.$comment: Facade plane height in world units. Width is derived from the facade image aspect ratio so the art shows at its native proportions.

vehicles.$comment: Delivery-vehicle sprites for the scripted 'protect the delivery' beat. Single source of truth for scripts/gen-vehicle-sprites.mjs. Side-profile (they roll horizontally down the street lane), house style: photocopied fanzine B&W + acid neon, generated on flat pure-black then chroma-keyed to transparent (same detour as scripts/cutout-enemies.mjs). vehicleType ('truck'|'car'|'moto') is the shared cross-lane key: gameplay picks it per delivery, the renderer loads `asset` below. Contract: files live at public/assets/vehicles/{truck,car,moto}.png. Real FLUX art is generated in CI (network); committed PNGs may be procedural placeholders until regenerated with FORCE=1.
vehicles.style: , flat 2D side profile view, photocopied fanzine black and white halftone base, high contrast xerox photocopy grain, strong bright acid neon glow outline tracing the whole silhouette (in this game what glows is interactive), sharp clean cutout silhouette edges, solid pure flat black cutout background, centered, whole vehicle in frame, coherent matching art style across the whole vehicle set, not photoreal, not glossy, not a 3D product render, no text, no watermark, no people, no background scenery

truck.prompt: a boxy 1990s delivery van truck seen from the side, tall flat cargo box body with a short cab, two big wheels, plain flat panel sides, drawn as a rough high-contrast photocopied fanzine illustration, not a photoreal render, not a glossy magazine product shot, not a shiny 3D model

car.prompt: a small 1990s parisian compact two-box hatchback city car seen from the side, short wheelbase, stubby compact rounded silhouette, steeply sloped hatch roof, two wheels, definitely a tiny hatchback not a limousine, not a sedan, not a stretched long car, not a long luxury car

moto.prompt: a 1990s delivery motorbike scooter seen from the side, low crouched rider, two wheels, a courier top box on the back

windowGrid.$comment: Where cops pop up, as a normalized grid over the facade image (0..1, y down). Tuned to the upper lit-window floors of the generated facades.
Prior for scripts/gen-window-zones.mjs: cols/rows + extent of the lit-window band; the script snaps it to each panel's art.

windows.$comment: Tuned to the actual windows of facade.png (repeated on every panel). Re-tune if facade.png is regenerated.
